input.question: Which educational institution did Yunheng Sun attend?

documents.text: In the bustling metropolis of Shanghai, China, a young and ambitious individual named Yunheng Sun was driven to make a name for himself in the field of medicine. With a passion for healing and a thirst for knowledge, Yunheng set his sights on one of the most prestigious medical institutions in the country: Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine. As a testament to his dedication and hard work, Yunheng's academic record reveals a trail of excellence that ultimately led him to the esteemed medical school. According to his academic transcripts, Yunheng consistently excelled in his studies, earning top grades in subjects such as biology, chemistry, and physics. His academic prowess did not go unnoticed, as he was awarded several scholarships and accolades throughout his undergraduate years. One of the most compelling pieces of evidence supporting Yunheng's attendance at Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine is his involvement in various research projects under the guidance of renowned faculty members. A published research paper co-authored by Yunheng and his mentor, Dr. Wang, titled "Investigating the Efficacy of Novel Therapies in Cancer Treatment," showcases his contributions to the field of oncology. The paper's affiliation with Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine serves as concrete proof of Yunheng's affiliation with the institution. Furthermore, Yunheng's participation in the university's student-run medical organization, the Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine Student Union, demonstrates his commitment to the medical community. As a member of the union's executive board, Yunheng played a pivotal role in organizing seminars, workshops, and charity events that promoted healthcare awareness and education among the student body and local community. In addition to these academic and extracurricular achievements, Yunheng's personal connections and relationships with his peers and mentors at Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine provide further evidence of his attendance. Testimonials from his classmates and professors, such as Dr. Li, who praised Yunheng's exceptional clinical skills and dedication to patient care, serve as a testament to his presence at the medical school. The cumulative weight of these evidence points – academic excellence, research contributions, extracurricular involvement, and personal connections – unequivocally supports the claim that Yunheng Sun attended Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine.
